# WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner 5.0.3

Version 5.0.3 corrects the package maturity metadata. The previous PyPI upload carried a Beta development-status classifier that was not supported by a documented maturity decision. This release omits that classifier. Scanner behavior is unchanged from 5.0.2.

The release includes the same six-asset contract: standalone runtime, wheel, normalized source archive, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence. The tag workflow creates a draft from a verified protected-main commit and attests every asset. PyPI upload remains a separate protected trusted-publishing workflow.

Automated findings are evidence, not proof of WCAG, Section 508, or PDF/UA conformance. Manual review and assistive-technology testing remain necessary. Scan only authorized sites and documents; reports may contain sensitive source content.

## Assets

- `WCAG-Site-PDF-Scanner-v5.0.3.py`
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.3-py3-none-any.whl`
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.3.tar.gz`

- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
